summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13` into a temp directory, chmod+x's the extracted `bun` binary, and then invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` (~727KB, marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`). `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with hex-suffixed identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and string-property indirection tables. `math_init.js` is a Bun-bundled blob with a rotated string array (`WV8StW` performing `push(shift())` cycles) and a custom charset decoder (`hc1jfK9`); its filename has no relation to the package's stated microfrontend-testing purpose. The pattern executes attacker-supplied code under an alien runtime fetched at install time, evading Node-oriented static scanners. The lifecycle-hook auto-execution and payload/purpose mismatch match the alternate-runtime-dropper shape rather than a legitimate native-build or vendor-SDK download.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
